notifications.title: Done: Claim an outpost
notifications.body: Claim its reward from the quest card.

notifications.title: The Builders' Barrow rises
notifications.body: The first builders sleep in the Builders' Barrow with their mark, the rune that bound the old span to Yav. Their dead still guard it: break through and bring the rune back, or no stone will hold the new span. It is marked on the map at (-2, 5).
